rules: Incoming core-food commitments are subsets of each recipient core demand, not new demand added to all city cores.
Named producing-region obligations are not necessarily intermediary-city handling volumes.
Multi-region pools remain unsplit. Serving-network labels do not establish exclusive source regions.
Calorie origin fractions are never applied to product tonnes.
Null source capacity means unestablished, not zero production or unlimited surplus.
Raw saline water, fresh water, treated input and reused flow are distinct streams.
Calendar/civil-turn service means do not establish coincident peak demand or reliability.

Temporary occupancy scenarios at one city replace rather than accumulate; visitors may have their home demand represented elsewhere, so food additions are facility allocation screens, not a new global population diet.

closure_light_screens.status: Counterfactual comparison under the existing Orison yield/light assumptions; not adopted capacity, species yield or incremental electricity allocation. Velis retains its separate explicit canopy/load case.
